name: quality-principles-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the code-quality disciplines that advise rather than enforce — approach deliberation and design patterns, OWASP security review and threat modeling, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, systematic debugging, measure-first performance, resilience with the merged error-handling and concurrency disciplines, dependency hygiene, and observability. Split out of quality-suite so a project can take the enforcing half without the advisory half's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /quality-principles-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
